theme_archetype.rationale: Authority, clarity, and function-first. A professional CRM needs high data density and contrast. We use a crisp white canvas with a commanding Dark Navy for structure, and stark functional colors for data status.
theme_archetype.persona_twist: Avoiding soft borders and muddy grays. Using crisp 1px borders, subtle layered shadows, and a highly legible, character-rich font pairing to kill the generic SaaS look.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Optical alignment and deliberate negative space. The 'Control Room' grid for dashboards.

navigation_structure.mobile: Mobile-first PWA. Fixed bottom navigation bar (h-16) with 5 key icons: Dashboard, Leads, Calls, WhatsApp, Tasks. Top header (h-14) for Global Search and Profile.
navigation_structure.desktop: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) with Dark Navy background (#0B1B3D) and White text. Main content area offset by ml-64.

cards.style: Flat, pure white background (#FFFFFF). Crisp 1px border (#E2E8F0).

buttons.primary: bg-[#0B1B3D] text-white hover:bg-[#142D66] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0F172A] border border-[#E2E8F0] hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#64748B] hover:bg-[#F1F5F9] hover:text-[#0F172A] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0B1B3D]/20 focus:border-[#0B1B3D] transition-all

kanban_board.card_bg: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-md p-3 shadow-sm cursor-grab hover:border-[#0B1B3D]/30 transition-colors

whatsapp_ui.message_bubble_in: bg-white rounded-lg rounded-tl-none p-3 max-w-[85%] shadow-sm
whatsapp_ui.message_bubble_out: bg-[#D9FDD3] rounded-lg rounded-tr-none p-3 max-w-[85%] shadow-sm

badges.style: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background or border color on hover. Text contrast must increase or remain accessible.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease.
interactions_and_motion.scrollbars: Custom styled scrollbars. Thin, transparent track, dark navy or slate thumb. No bulky default gutters.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Must look sharp and professional.

testing.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

login_background.description: Dark glass facade of a modern building. Use as a split-screen background on the login page (Desktop) with a dark overlay.

empty_state_workspace.description: Modern office interior with white desks. Use for 'No Leads Found' or 'No Tasks' empty states, wrapped in a grayscale filter with high transparency.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Professional man standing in front of a building. Use as a default avatar for the authenticated user or employee list.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic Tailwind blue/gray defaults if they clash with the Navy/White theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Ensure Mobile PWA styling. Implement the fixed bottom navigation exactly as described for small viewports, hidden on desktop. Sidebar hidden on mobile, fixed on desktop.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Dropdowns, Tabs) but strip heavy borders/radius to match the 'rounded-md' crisp look.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Integrate 'Cabinet Grotesk' via font-face or Google Fonts equivalent if unavailable (like 'Space Grotesk' as fallback, but aim for Cabinet Grotesk from Fontshare).
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not use generic placeholder image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash URLs in the media_and_images section.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add data-testid to every CTA, form input, and major navigation link.
